output: Ranked first, [PSI-99] SAFFIRE-II achieves a total score of 74.8/100 by earning full points for solid habitat materials (20/20) and data richness (10/10), alongside strong oxygen relevance and ventilated airflow scores. Second-ranked [PSI-98] SAFFIRE-I (74.3/100) follows closely with identical maximum material and richness scores, tested at 21.5–21.7% O₂ with 20 cm/s airflow. Third-ranked [PSI-25] BASS-II (72.9/100) also attains full material and richness scores while covering two safety pillars (prevention and suppression), despite receiving zero points for unreported airflow.
